title: Nook Works Application Shell Integration Probe
summary: 以一個真的可登入的小型 Nook Works Shell Live Demo，組合既有 Auth、app_user、Native Data API / Custom API、Navigation、Route、Feature Entry 與 iPad-first responsive capability，驗證 Application Runtime lifecycle 與責任邊界。
flow: Login / Session Restore → Auth Identity → app_user → Application Context → Shell → Feature → Data Access → Render
